Create a premium production-quality visual direction for a cinematic website intro ABOVE the existing WattTrace hero. Single concept named "THE FIRST TRACE". Target 1536x1024 presentation board: upper 78% is one realistic full-width website intro keyframe, bottom 22% a restrained three-shot storyboard strip for the SAME film with time labels 00:00, 00:04, 00:08. Not three alternative concepts. Attached reference 1 is ONLY inspiration for full-bleed film composition, restrained top nav, enormous bottom wordmark and chapter navigation; do NOT copy flowers, aircraft, ActClarity brand or any of its graphics. Reference 2 is current WattTrace identity and palette; reference 3 is exact approved logo to preserve, including light wordmark. 
Art direction: extraordinary cinematic macro photograph of a beautiful industrial chart recorder: brushed champagne-metal mechanical stylus rests on a wide warm ivory roll of graph paper. The stylus is actually recording one copper-brown energy trace, a single gentle deviation peak visible. Extreme tactile paper fibres, precise mechanical construction, shallow depth of field, calm hard side-light, deep espresso shadows and subtle blueberry reflections. Sophisticated industrial instrument, NOT fountain pen, old-fashioned writing quill, wax seal, typewriter or abstract blobs. Wide camera angle with instrument on right two-thirds and clear dark negative space for text lower left. Main scene is dark espresso and warm latte, subtly cinematic, beautifully credible editorial still. 
Integrated interface: small approved WattTrace logo at top left in cream, sparse nav "Offers  Platform  Evaluation", right "Explore demo". Left-mid small chapter list "01 / SOURCE", "02 / TRACE", "03 / REVIEW". Lower left huge elegant light-weight wordmark text "WattTrace" in cream; lower right short line "Every decision begins with a trace." and a small "Explore WattTrace ↓" button. Tiny "CONCEPT FILM · ILLUSTRATIVE" and pause control. Nothing resembles a live reading, no invented metrics. The regular hero is only hinted by a 25px latte edge below the intro.
Bottom storyboard with clean image stills: paper enters frame at00:00; stylus draws one deviation at00:04; camera pulls back revealing the measured record at00:08. Heading above strip "THE FIRST TRACE / 10-SECOND INTRO". Small footer "Reduced motion: still poster + optional play". Keep text large and readable. Concept is a film direction, not rendered functional video. Current date2026-10-23; do not display dates. Keep only this one direction, exquisite realism, no device/browser chrome.

Art direction: architectural industrial cinema, shot from low human height inside a spotless tall manufacturing hall looking upward into layered huge brushed-metal pipe bends, overhead service bridges and warm frosted skylights. Beautifully composed sculptural curves frame an open central vanishing point. Champagne and dark mocha metals, softly blueberry-painted machinery, daylight beams and faint atmospheric dust. Credible real factory architecture, no fake glowing holographic diagrams, no neon, no dashboards. A carefully restrained thin copper graphic trace follows ONE pipe and fades into the composition, explicitly a graphic illustration not live telemetry. Clear warm dark espresso negative space bottom left. The scale is monumental but calm, quiet cinematic luxury. More modern than nostalgic.
UI integrated: exact logo small in cream top-left; sparse nav "Offers  Platform  Evaluation"; "Explore demo" top-right. Oversized lightweight "WattTrace" across lower-left. Lower right "See the plant. Understand the context." plus subtle "Explore WattTrace ↓" button. Quiet left chapter markers "01 / ENERGY", "02 / CONTEXT", "03 / DECISION". Small pause and "CONCEPT FILM · ILLUSTRATIVE". Only a sliver of latte below implying regular hero follows; no dashboard or busy cards. Contrast makes all copy readable.

Visual: museum-quality photoreal 3D still life of an industrial compressor impeller and housing on an immense matte warm-latte surface. A suspended exploded assembly elegantly separates into three components horizontally across the upper/right two-thirds, all axis-aligned and physically plausible. Brushed mocha/champagne metal, ceramic ivory casing, muted blueberry inner impeller, finely detailed but not cluttered, soft warm studio side-light and long quiet shadows. Beneath the three suspended parts a narrow sheet of ivory recording paper curves gently across the stage, bearing ONE thin copper trace. A small transparent-blueberry slice highlights the relationship between mechanical context and a trace, without labels or numeric metrics. No holographic neon, glass UI, particles, fake telemetry or unrealistic control effects. Pure editorial industrial sculpture, generous empty lower-left for type, very premium and calm. Clearly illustrative equipment, not technical proof.
